newsitem.title: USA: Calton has new BankBoston credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Calton has new BankBoston credit facility.

text.p: Calton Inc said Thursday it has entered into a new revolving credit facility with BankBoston Corp providing borrowing availability of $45.0 million that will not be reduced during its initial three-year term.
At the request of the company, BankBoston has an option at the end of each year to extend the facility for an additional year, thereby resulting in an ongoing three-year term.
As a component of the credit agreement, Calton said, it issued 1.0 million warrants to BankBoston to purchase an equivalent number of common shares shares for $0.50 each over a seven-year term.
The new facility contains more favorable terms than the facility it replaces, including an interest rate of prime plus one point, Calton said, adding this was a 1.5 point improvement.
It said the new facility also provides a Eurodollar interest rate option, providing the company with more financial and operating flexibility.
Company officials were not immediately available to provide further details about the previous credit agreement.
